title: C-reenshots
description: Clientside command+keybind to open the current screenshots folder!
body:
This is a very simple mod I created that adds one command, and one keybind.



-The command is /scf - This has no arguments.

-The keybind is by default bound to "INSERT", but is easily changable in the controls menu in Minecraft.

Both of these trigger the same operation, which is opening the "current" screenshots folder, as in, the screenshots folder inside the ".minecraft" or "minecraft" directory this mod is installed in.



This is completely cross-platform as far as I have tested.



If you find a bug, please contact me on Discord: "iredmc"
